exposure: transfusion of packed red blood cell
cohort: The study included 275 premature newborns (125 girls, 150 boys) admitted to Namazee NICU in Southwestern Iran during 2022.
finding: The prevalence of IVH was 20.4%, and preterm newborns with a gestational age between 28+1 and 30+6 weeks had a twofold increased risk of developing IVH.
cross-section timing: Admissions during 2022, with IVH diagnosis confirmed within 7 days after birth.
gest_age: Mean 29.22 ± 1.44 weeks; the study focused on newborns ≤ 32 weeks, with increased IVH risk for those 28+1 to 30+6 weeks.
